text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"paragraph openings with examples like \"Practice makes perfect\" and \"Do something different from everybody else\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into clearer body paragraphs with distinct supporting points that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"basketball team / online class personal anecdotes","quality":"development","description":"It develops ideas with specific experiences and explanations rather than mostly repeating the same claim."},{"evidence":"\"I agree with Emerson statement because...\" and \"At the end of all of your hard work\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing shows somewhat better control of sentence structure and combines ideas more effectively, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"\"Practice makes perfect\" / \"get out of your comfort zone\" / \"work hard\"","quality":"idea coherence","description":"Its points stay more focused on a central argument and connect back to the thesis more consistently."},{"evidence":"\"I've gotten better from working hard and never giving up on myself\"","quality":"grammar and usage","description":"It has fewer severe word-choice and agreement problems that interfere with meaning."}]}
